title: Surjectivity of coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $S$ be any set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Restricting a vector in $\mathbb F_2^n$ to the coordinates in $S$ defines a surjective linear map from $\mathbb F_2^n$ to the space of functions $S\to\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: finite set S of coordinates in {0,…,n−1}
